MemoriaHub CLI v1.3.4
Usage: memoriahub folders add [options] <path>

Add a folder to the managed registry

Arguments:
  path             Path to the folder to register

Options:
  -r, --recursive  Watch sub-directories recursively (default: false)
  --disabled       Add the folder in disabled state (default: false)
  -h, --help       display help for command
